topic_identification.title_bengali: প্রতিবন্ধী ব্যক্তি ও তৃতীয় লিঙ্গের ব্যক্তিদের নিয়োগের জন্য কর রেয়াত
topic_identification.title_english: Tax relief for employment of disabled persons and third gender individuals

other_act_references: প্রতিবন্ধী ব্যক্তিদের অধিকার ও সুরক্ষা আইন ২০১৩

main_provision.bengali_text:
কোনো করদাতা নিয়োগকারী কর্তৃপক্ষ হিসেবে তার প্রতিষ্ঠানে কর্মরত মোট জনবলের অনূন ১০% (দশ শতাংশ) অথবা ২৫ (পঁচিশ) জনের অধিক কর্মচারী প্রতিবন্ধী ব্যক্তিদের মধ্যে হতে নিয়োগ করলে উক্ত করদাতা তার প্রদেয় করের ৫% (পাঁচ শতাংশ) অথবা প্রতিবন্ধী ব্যক্তি-কর্মচারীগণের পরিশোধিত মোট বেতনের ৭৫% (পঁচাত্তর শতাংশ), যা কম, কর রেয়াত প্রাপ্ত হবেন।

main_provision.english_summary: Taxpayers who employ disabled persons or third gender individuals comprising at least 10% of total workforce or 25+ employees are entitled to tax relief equal to 5% of payable tax or 75% of total salaries paid to such employees, whichever is lower.
key_points: Applies to disabled persons and third gender individuals separately
Minimum threshold: 10% of workforce OR 25+ employees
Tax relief: 5% of payable tax OR 75% of salaries paid, whichever is lower
Relief applies to each category independently
main_provision.scope_application: All taxpaying employers who hire disabled persons or third gender individuals meeting the minimum thresholds

mandatory_conditions: Employee must be from disabled persons or third gender category
Must meet minimum threshold (10% of workforce OR 25+ employees)
Proper documentation of employment and salary payments required

formulas.description: Tax relief calculation for employing disabled persons

variables.Payable_Tax: Total income tax payable by the employer
variables.Total_Disabled_Salaries: Sum of salaries paid to disabled employees

examples.scenario: Company with 100 employees, 12 disabled, payable tax 1,000,000 Taka, disabled salaries 2,400,000 Taka

formulas.description: Tax relief calculation for employing third gender individuals

variables.Payable_Tax: Total income tax payable by the employer
variables.Total_ThirdGender_Salaries: Sum of salaries paid to third gender employees

tables_and_schedules.description: Minimum employment thresholds for tax relief eligibility

examples.scenario: Manufacturing company with 200 employees wants to claim tax relief for employing disabled persons
examples.explanation: Company qualifies for relief and receives 100,000 Taka reduction in tax liability

compliance_requirements: Maintain proper employment records for disabled/third gender employees
Provide salary payment records and proof of payments
Include relief claim in annual tax return with supporting documents
common_mistakes: Counting part-time employees incorrectly in workforce calculations
Claiming relief for both categories without meeting individual thresholds
Not maintaining proper documentation for employee categories
Miscalculating relief amount by using wrong formula
best_practices: Maintain detailed employee category records throughout the year
Calculate relief eligibility quarterly to track progress
Ensure proper verification of employee disability/gender status
Consult with tax professional for complex workforce calculations
required_documents: Employee disability certificates from authorized medical board
Third gender identity certificates from competent authority
Bank transfer receipts for salary payments
deadlines: Include relief claim in annual income tax return
Submit supporting documents with tax return filing
Maintain records for at least 6 years for audit purposes
